title: Stellar Developer Docs search (Mintlify search API)
description: Intent-named search operations over the Stellar developer documentation at developers.stellar.org (docs and protocol/developers meeting notes), served by the Mintlify search and page-content API for the site's Mintlify project. Authored spec-as-data in the spirit of Cloudflare codemode's OpenAPI connector: each operation declares {id, description, params} for the unified catalog plus a `mintlify` block that records the exact request and path filter for the execute adapter. Every operation was verified live against the API (see per-operation `verified`).
authoredBy: Mintlify migration (.agents/TODO.md); API research in research/services/stellar-docs-mintlify.md; original operation design in research/services/stellar-docs-spec-design.md

backend.retry: one host; retry once on network error, timeout, or HTTP 5xx; never retry 4xx; 429 returns immediately

constraints.resultShape: Search returns an array of { path, content, metadata: { title } }: one entry per section chunk, no score, no anchor, no total count. A page can appear more than once.
constraints.noFacets: filter.version, filter.language and filter.tag had no effect (the site defines none), and scoreThreshold did not change any result set (measured 2026-11-02). Category and meetings scoping happens adapter-side by path prefix.
constraints.alwaysReturns: The semantic search returns its nearest sections even for nonsense queries. The adapter reports soft-empty only when no kept section contains a query term.
constraints.candidateWindow: pageSize is at most 50, so path-filtered operations see at most 50 candidates.
constraints.pagePaths: The page endpoint takes the path without a leading slash and returns 404 { message: "Page not found" } for an unknown path.

catalogHints.note: Each operation maps 1:1 to a CatalogEntry: id, description and params (inputSchema) verbatim; transport from backend plus operation.mintlify.

operations.name: search_docs
operations.description: Full-text keyword search across ALL official Stellar developer documentation on developers.stellar.org — every docs page under /docs/build, /docs/learn, /docs/tokens, /docs/data, /docs/tools, /docs/platforms, /docs/validators and /docs/networks. Use for any question about Stellar or Soroban: how do I write, test and deploy a smart contract; how do I issue an asset or create a token, add a trustline, use clawback or authorization flags for regulated assets; how does the protocol work (ledger, accounts, transactions, operations, fees, consensus); which SEP or CAP defines a standard; Stellar RPC and Horizon APIs; the Stellar CLI, Lab, Quickstart and official SDKs; anchor deposits, withdrawals and KYC; building wallets and dapps; testnet, futurenet and mainnet networks; stellar-core and protocol versions. Returns doc sections with URL, page path, page title, section heading and a content snippet. A soft-empty result means no returned section contains a query term; returned hits still need judging by snippet.

includeContent.description: Add full section `content` to each returned hit (can be multi-KB per hit; keep hitsPerPage small or project fields before returning).

operations.returns: { hits: Array of hits: { url, path, title, section?, snippet, content? } } plus { candidates }.

hits.description: The hits live under `data.hits`; `data` itself is not an array.

url.description: Page URL on developers.stellar.org. Sections have no anchor.

path.description: Site-relative page path, e.g. /docs/tokens/how-to-issue-an-asset. Pass it to get_doc_page to read the page.

section.description: Heading of the matched section, when the section starts with one.

snippet.description: Up to about 300 characters of the section, centered on the first query term found.

content.description: Present only with includeContent: true. The whole matched section as Markdown; it can be several KB.

candidates.description: Sections the search service returned for the query. It is a window size, not a corpus count.

operations.name: search_doc_titles
operations.description: Title-ranked search over Stellar developer docs pages: one hit per page, ranked by the page title and URL path. The fastest way to find the one canonical docs page for a topic when you roughly know what it is called — e.g. 'State Archival', 'Stellar Consensus Protocol', 'How to Issue an Asset', 'Stellar Asset Contract', 'Migrate from Horizon to RPC', 'Anchor Platform', 'Stellar CLI'. Returns one row per page so results are page-level and precise instead of content-fuzzy; follow up with get_doc_page or includeContent on search_docs to read the page.

query.description: Expected page/section title words, e.g. 'state archival' or 'issue asset'.

operations.returns: { hits: Array of hits (page/heading level): { url, path, title, section?, snippet } } plus { candidates }.

operations.name: search_docs_in_category
operations.description: Keyword search restricted to ONE top-level category of the Stellar developer docs. Categories: build (smart contracts, guides, apps/dapps, security, agentic payments), data (Stellar RPC, Horizon, Hubble analytics, indexers/Galexie, oracles), tools (Stellar CLI, Lab, Quickstart, SDKs, developer tools), learn (protocol fundamentals: ledgers, accounts, transactions, operations, fees, consensus, lumens XLM, anchors, SEPs, migrate from EVM), platforms (Anchor Platform, Stellar Disbursement Platform), validators (running a stellar-core validator node), tokens (issuing assets, asset anatomy, access control, Stellar Asset Contract, token interface), networks (resource limits and fees), and meetings (protocol and developer meeting notes). Use when a question clearly belongs to one area and general search returns cross-area noise.

category.description: Top-level docs area; maps to the /docs/<category> URL prefix (meetings → the /meetings slice).

hitsPerPage.description: Number of category-filtered hits to return.

includeContent.description: Add full section `content` to each returned hit (can be multi-KB per hit; keep hitsPerPage small or project fields before returning).

operations.returns: { hits: Array of hits limited to the category: { url, path, title, section?, snippet, content? } } plus { candidates, pathFiltered }.

operations.name: get_doc_page
operations.description: Fetch the full text of a single Stellar developer docs page identified by its URL path, e.g. /docs/build/smart-contracts/getting-started/storing-data or /docs/learn/fundamentals/stellar-consensus-protocol. Use after a search hit to read a whole page instead of a single snippet — the docs equivalent of opening the page. Returns the page title and the full page content in on-page order, with headings, tables and code blocks.

path.description: URL path of the page on developers.stellar.org, no domain — e.g. /docs/build/smart-contracts/getting-started/storing-data. Use `path` from a search hit. An anchor or trailing slash is ignored.

operations.returns: An object with url, path, title, and content (the whole page as Markdown).

title.description: The page's H1 title, or the last path segment when the page has none.

content.description: The whole page as Markdown. Large reference pages can exceed 20 KB.
